lines.zh: 它顶着一对大牙小步走
lines.en: It walks in short steps, big front teeth showing.
Its long tail sways behind it.
It sniffs along the ground.

lines.zh: 它绕着南洋杉转了一圈
lines.en: It circles an araucaria once.

lines.zh: 细腿踩过松针，声音很轻
lines.en: Thin legs over pine needles, softly.
It halts and cocks its head.
It steps over a fallen twig.
It comes along the lake shore.

lines.zh: 它嗅到什么东西，快走两步
lines.en: Something catches its nose and it hurries.

lines.zh: 它一边走一边左顾右盼
lines.en: It walks with its head turning.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在土上留下小印
lines.en: Its claws leave small prints.

lines.zh: 它从树林边穿到雪林边
lines.en: It passes from forest edge to snowy wood.
It ducks under low branches.
It stops only by a heap of cones.

lines.zh: 它把鼻子凑近地面嗅闻
lines.en: It puts its nose right to the ground.
It looks up into the canopy.
It crouches and preens.

lines.zh: 它把大牙在树枝上磨了磨
lines.en: It hones its big teeth on a branch.
It eyes the cones overhead.
It shakes itself all over.
It crouches, tail on the ground.

lines.zh: 它把一颗球果拨来拨去
lines.en: It rolls a cone back and forth.
It cocks its head to listen.
Its feathers fluff up.
It blinks slowly.
It brings a claw to its mouth.
It stands as if dozing.
A pine needle lands on its head.
It shakes the needle off.
Its breathing is fine and quick.
It looks up at you, direct.
It tilts its head at your hands.
It backs off one small step.
Its tail flicks nervously.
Then it cannot help coming closer.
It sniffs at your shoe.
Those big teeth show.
It does not mean to bite; it just watches.
It backs off and looks back.
It is not quite easy with you.
It shrieks and bolts.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了几根在松针上
lines.en: Feathers fall onto the needles.

lines.zh: 它跑了两步又绊了一下
lines.en: It runs two strides and stumbles.
It shrinks into the ferns.
It stands crooked, breathing fast.
Blood beads at the wound.
It props itself on a claw.
It gives a low call.
It trembles and watches you.

lines.zh: 它还是想回到球果那边
lines.en: It still wants to get back to the cones.

lines.zh: 它朝你手上的球果来了
lines.en: It comes for the cone in your hand.

lines.zh: 它一口咬住，咬得咔咔响
lines.en: It bites down; the shell cracks.
Its big teeth pry the shell open.
It gets more out than cracking by hand.

lines.zh: 它把种子一颗颗挑出来
lines.en: It picks the seeds out one by one.

lines.zh: 它边吃边看你还有没有
lines.en: It eats while checking for more.
It pins the cone under a claw.
Crumbs stick around its mouth.
It bobs its head, content.
Done, it sidles up to your hand.
It hops half a step clear.

lines.zh: 被撞得跳开，落地就钻回灌木。
lines.en: Knocked away, I land and dive straight into the brush.

lines.zh: 它的头撞在你腿上，很轻
lines.en: Its head taps your leg.
It squeezes past your foot.

lines.zh: 它的爪子刮到了你的鞋
lines.en: A claw scrapes your shoe.
It backs off and ruffles its feathers.
It ducks low, ready to run.
Sure you are still, it relaxes.
It goes back to its cone.

lines.zh: 它好像很快忘了这一撞
lines.en: It seems to forget the bump quickly.

lines.zh: 两只凑在一起，头挨着头
lines.en: Two stand with their heads together.
They preen each other's necks.

lines.zh: 一只把球果推给另一只
lines.en: One pushes a cone to the other.
They take turns cracking the same one.

lines.zh: 它们的尾巴几乎并在一起
lines.en: Their tails lie nearly as one.
They look up at the canopy together.
One walks; the other follows.
They crouch pressed together.
Their feathers tangle like dry grass.
They stay quiet a long while.
It picks up the cone in its teeth.

lines.zh: 它把球果压在爪下咬开
lines.en: It pins the cone and bites it open.
It picks out the seeds and swallows.
It flicks the empty shell aside.

lines.zh: 它把吃剩的种子藏起来
lines.en: It hides the leftover seeds.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅不合口的东西
lines.en: It sniffs at what it does not want.
It pushes it under the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 它小心地咬，不弄碎种子
lines.en: It bites carefully, sparing the seeds.
Afterward it licks its teeth.
It starts hunting the next cone.
Its head comes up sharply.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一下就绷紧了
lines.en: Its tail goes stiff.
It turns side-on and stops eating.
It opens its mouth once.
It makes a short, sharp sound.

lines.zh: 它把身体压低，退了一步
lines.en: It ducks and gives a step.

lines.zh: 大牙咬紧球果，眼睛找着石缝。
lines.en: My big teeth clamp a cone while my eyes hunt for a crevice.
Its breathing clearly quickens.
It glances once at the cone.
It decides to hide first.
It edges toward the bushes.
Its movements turn very careful.
It hides behind a low branch.
It watches you through the gap.
It inches along to the side.
It tries to run and stops.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在松针上打滑
lines.en: Its claws slip on the needles.
It changes direction and tries again.
Its tail stays low.
It tries to make no sound.
It crouches into a fern.
Only its eyes still show.
You move; it shrinks deeper.
It slips behind a stone.
It waits for you to leave.
It bites the toe of your boot.

lines.zh: 大牙在皮革上磕了一下
lines.en: Those teeth knock on leather.
It butts your shin.
It hops and snaps at your hand.
Its claws catch your trouser leg.
It clamps on and pulls back.
It bites air; the teeth clack.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴甩得，我抓不住。
lines.en: Its tail whips and I cannot catch hold.
It fights while backing away.
It retreats into the ferns, head out.

lines.zh: 它的动作很急，没有章法
lines.en: Its attacks come panicked, unplanned.
It bites and flees.

lines.zh: 松针里传来细小的动静
lines.en: A small noise comes from the needles.
It steps out from between roots.
Its long tail shows out of the grass first.
It walks over to a heap of cones.
It sniffs once.
It picks one up and starts cracking.
Shell fragments fall at its feet.
It is wholly absorbed in eating.
Then its head comes up.
It realises it is not alone.
It does not leave at once.
It looks for a while first.
Its tail sways slowly.
It has noted where you are.
Singed feathers set it thrashing.
It flips over on landing.
In water it beats frantically.
The blast throws it into the litter.
An arrow grazes its wing.
Odd force jerks its whole body.

lines.zh: 饿得发抖，它连壳都不咬
lines.en: Starving, it will not even crack a cone.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，羽毛竖起
lines.en: Lightning locks it stiff, feathers up.
The void tugs; its legs kick wildly.
